stem: A child has conotruncal congenital heart disease, palatal abnormality, immune problems and characteristic facial features. Which genetic syndrome is most likely?
explanation: 22q11.2 deletion syndrome can present with conotruncal heart defects, palatal abnormalities, immune deficiency and characteristic facial features.
